_note: Damage-relevant numeric models of runes, from data/runes.json descriptions. levelRange [lo,hi] interpolates over levels 1->15. bonusAd folds into total AD; burstProc = one-time damage in the combo (flat + adRatio*bonusAD + apRatio*AP); onHit = per-auto bonus; ampPct = % combo damage amp. PoC scope: Graves-relevant runes.

Electrocute._why_units: adRatio/apRatio converted from fractions to PERCENT to match rune_engine.json; both engines now divide by 100 exactly once. type was 'physical' here and 'magic' in rune_engine.json for the same rune -- the description says Adaptive, so it is adaptive.

Conqueror._why_heal: Patch 7.3 grants 3-5 AD or 5-8.33 AP per stack. The synthetic stat block uses three stacks as the average damage state, follows the build's dominant adaptive stat, and applies full-stack healing only after a three-second ramp.

Dark Harvest._why: 35 (+10% bonus AD / +5% AP) adaptive, +11 per soul permanently. The target-below-50% condition is CHECKED by the rotation. Soul acquisition is execution/snowball dependent, so it is disclosed as 0 / 8 / 16 souls: floor, midpoint expectation, and a practical strong-game ceiling scenario (not a literal stack cap). No public source provides a true average; 8 preserves the previous midpoint estimate.
Dark Harvest._why_cd: '(20 second cooldown. Resets to 1 second on takedown.)' The 20s is used: a takedown mid-duel is not something the model can know about. perSoul 10 -> 11 to match the rune's own text, 'permanently increasing Dark Harvest's damage by 11'.

Phase Rush._why: melee 40%/60% MS + 25 haste on 3-hit proc; ~60% fight uptime of the 40% roll

Grasp of the Undying._why: At four combat stacks, the attack deals 2% of the user's max Health and heals 1.3% of the user's max Health. Ranged champions receive 60% of both effects. Permanent Health from earlier procs is match-history dependent and is not granted for free.

Lethal Tempo._why: Patch 7.3: attack speed ramps over six landed attacks. Only attacks after full stacks fire the adaptive bullet, whose damage scales with the build's bonus Attack Speed.

Fleet Footwork._why: The heal includes its level value and AD/AP ratios. The 20% Move Speed for one second is averaged over the same conservative nine-second energized cadence; mana/energy restoration is disclosed but not converted into damage.

Font of Life._why: The current tooltip gives 15s cooldown, 1% max Health + 5% AP to the user, 1.5% max Health + 5% AP to the nearby ally, and 130% effectiveness for melee champions.

Coup de Grace.note: vs targets <40% HP (approx: applied to kill combo)

Last Stand.note: only when YOU are <60% HP — 0 for burst-from-full

Legend: Bloodline._why: 'Gain 1% omnivamp, up to bonus 7% ... when taking down' -- only the guaranteed 1% is modelled. The ramp needs takedowns, which a 1v1 simulation cannot produce, and averaging it in would price the rune off a condition the engine never checks.

Celerity._why: 2% MS; all MS bonuses on you increased 7%

Nimbus Cloak._why: 10-40% MS for 3s on summoner cast; avg fight uptime approximation

Gathering Storm._why: scaling AD by game time, ~15min value (8 ad x2? use 16 approximation)

Legend: Alacrity._why: Patch 7.3's attack-speed appendix confirms 18% at maximum stacks.

Overgrowth._why: Thirty stacks grant 90 flat Health, then increase max Health by 3%. Further infinite stacks depend on match farming and are not granted for free.

Bone Plating._why: blocks 3 champion hits per trigger; ~5% effective DR over a fight

Second Wind._why: After champion damage, regenerate 3 + 1.5% missing Health over five seconds, doubled for melee. The engine uses its documented 40% in-fight missing-Health assumption.

Revitalize._why: 5% is always active. The additional 10% applies only while the healed or shielded target is below 40% Health and remains a disclosed context-dependent ceiling.
